summary: Backend-only testing for 4 new features (Quick Reschedule, Daily Summary Email loop, Overdue Jobs Badge, Signature Capture). Added 14 new pytest cases covering is_overdue flag on GET /api/jobs, overdue=true filter with staff scoping, dashboard overdue stat (admin + staff scoping), signature_data persistence on Completed status change, optional signature, and Rescheduled still requires scheduled_date/time. All 57 executed tests pass (3 skipped - pre-existing disabled test user from prior iteration, no regression). No backend regressions on auth/users/categories/customers/jobs/dashboard/earnings/notifications. Daily Summary Email loop is a server-side background task not directly asserted via HTTP (would require SMTP mock); flagged as not covered.

minor.issue: If overdue=true is combined with date_from/date_to, the date range filter OVERWRITES the scheduled_at:{$lt:now} constraint set by overdue (server.py:787 replaces query['scheduled_at']). Low priority since UI uses overdue filter standalone, but could yield unexpected results if both are set.

action_items: Consider adding a backend integration test or trigger endpoint for the Daily Summary Email loop so it can be asserted (currently only reachable via time-based background task).
Optional: in list_jobs, merge the overdue scheduled_at:{$lt:now} with date_from/date_to range instead of overwriting (server.py line ~787).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1041 lines — approaching the 700-line split threshold; consider modularizing routers (auth, jobs, dashboard, users).
enrich_jobs computes is_overdue correctly for Completed/Cancelled → always False (verified via tests).
StatusChangeIn.signature_data is optional (OK). signature_captured_at is only set when signature_data provided (OK).
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed customers, categories, and jobs; all idempotent across runs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run with `-n 0` (serial). Tests rely on shared STATE dict; TestOverdueAndSignature must run after TestJobs/TestChangePassword and re-logins staff2 to avoid invalidated token issue. New feature endpoints verified: GET /api/jobs?overdue=true (admin + staff scoping), is_overdue flag presence+correctness for Scheduled/Rescheduled/Completed/Cancelled, dashboard overdue count, signature_data persistence. Daily Summary Email background loop NOT directly tested — no HTTP trigger exposed.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs discovered; initial test failure (staff2 overdue stat KeyError) was caused by stale staff2_tok invalidated by the earlier change-password test. Fixed by re-logging in staff2 inside the test.
